headword: {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}
gloss: limit on the number of people; headcount restriction; capacity limit

definitions.gloss: limit on the number of people; headcount restriction; capacity limit
definitions.explanation: A rule that restricts how many people can enter, participate, or be admitted to a place, event, or service. Seen in contexts such as event registration, restaurant seating, class enrollment, and safety regulations.

examples.japanese: {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a limit on the number of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けています→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Admission has a limit on the number of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}して→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This tour has a capacity limit, so please book early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: As a measure against infectious disease, we are limiting the number of people in the store.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧ (number of people) + ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (limit, restriction). A very common expression in announcements about events, classes, facilities, and tours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a limit on the number of people
- {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set a limit on the number of people
- {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the capacity limit
- {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: to lift the capacity limit
- {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}なし: no limit on the number of people
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧{人数制限|にんずうせいげん}: admission capacity limit

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧: fixed capacity; quota — the specified number that a place can hold
- ⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧: upper limit — the maximum allowed number
- ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: limit; restriction — general term for limits
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: admission restrictions — broader than {人数制限|にんずうせいげん}; can include other conditions

USAGE:
{人数制限|にんずうせいげん} became especially common in Japanese public life during the COVID-19 pandemic, when many venues limited how many people could enter. The phrase continues to appear in announcements for tours, classes, restaurants, and similar settings.
